_comment: GENERATED-BY-HAND, not by tools/vendor_wamr.py. `covers` names every file whose bytes are part of MOY_WASM_FORMAT_VERSION's meaning -- the vendored AOT loader and runtime ABI, never the interpreter or the compiler's sources, which a module never depends on -- plus `compilers`, the wamrc pins in tools/wasm_module.py's COMPILERS that this format's modules were built with. `stamp` is tools/wasm_module.py's format_stamp() over both, in this order. Bump MOY_WASM_FORMAT_VERSION in moy_wasm_key.h and re-run `python3 tools/wasm_module.py format-stamp --write` (or hand-edit `stamp`) in the SAME commit that changes any of this -- that is what tests/test_wasm_format_version.py checks for. See moy_wasm_key.h's 'WHY A FORMAT VERSION' comment and docs/wasm_tier_plan_2026-09.md's 'A cart survives its firmware' (2026-09-30).
